statement: The Profetas producer identifies Listrão as the Porto Santo/Madeira name for the grape also known as Listán Blanco and Palomino Fino; CARTA reuses the existing Palomino Fino grape identity rather than creating a duplicate Listrão entity.
Louis/Dressner identifies Menu Pineau and Orbois as names for the same Loire grape in its Clos du Tue-Boeuf material.
